usedFor: Sage Sales Management holds contacts and opportunities, and HubSpot receives them with “Create or Update Contact” and “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Opportunity” in Sage Sales Management, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each new opportunity becomes a deal in HubSpot.

watchOut: “Opportunity Updated” also reaches “Create Deal”, so one opportunity can add several deals if you pick the update trigger.
